# ARCHITECTURE.md — {PROJECT_NAME}

> **Output file location:** project root (`/ARCHITECTURE.md`), not in `docs/`.
> **Why at root:** this is Tier 0 — read by every agent on every task, before touching any code.
> **Size limit: 6 KB.** If longer than that, the content is too detailed — move
> details to `docs/architecture/` and keep only boundaries here.
> Extended details are in `docs/architecture/OVERVIEW.md`; this file is the map, not the territory.

**Version:** {X.Y} | **Last updated:** {YYYY-MM-DD} | **Latest ADR:** {ADR-NNNN}

---

## 1. System summary (5 sentences maximum)

{What is being built, for whom, what the deployment shape is (monolith/modular monolith/
microservices/serverless), and the single most defining architectural constraint.}

Example:
> Multi-tenant web application for FMCG distributor order management. Modular monolith
> Next.js + PostgreSQL, deployed on Vercel + Supabase. Primary constraint: must sync
> bidirectionally with the client's Accurate ERP via REST, with max 5-minute delay tolerance.

---

## 2. Boundary — what IS and IS NOT inside the system

| Inside the system (we build & control) | Outside the system (we consume, do not control) |
|---|---|
| {Web app} | {Payment gateway — Midtrans} |
| {API layer} | {Client ERP — Accurate} |
| {Background worker} | {Email — Resend} |
| {Database} | {Object storage — R2} |

**Rule:** anything in the right column must have an entry in `docs/misc/INTEGRATIONS.md`
and a mock in `tests/mocks/`. No exceptions — including those that are "just one endpoint".

---

## 3. Modules & responsibilities

One line per module. If it cannot be described in one line, the module is too large.

| Module | Path | Responsibility | May be called by |
|---|---|---|---|
| {auth} | `src/modules/auth` | {Session, login, RBAC} | {all modules} |
| {orders} | `src/modules/orders` | {Order lifecycle, state machine} | {api, worker} |
| {billing} | `src/modules/billing` | {Invoice, payment} | {orders} |
| {integration-erp} | `src/modules/integration-erp` | {Sync to ERP} | {worker only} |

### Dependency rules (must be enforced, not suggestions)

```
{ui} → {modules} → {core/db}          ✅ allowed
{modules} → {ui}                       ❌ forbidden
{orders} → {billing}                   ✅ allowed (one-way)
{billing} → {orders}                   ❌ forbidden — use events, not direct imports
```

> If dependency-cruiser / eslint-plugin-boundaries is available, the rules above must have
> counterparts in config, and be checked by `gate:pr` in `VERIFY.md`. Architecture rules that
> are not enforced by CI are rules already violated and not yet discovered.

## 4. Key data flows

Write only the 2–4 most critical flows (the ones that kill the product if broken). Format: numbered steps,
not ASCII diagrams that are hard to maintain.

### Flow A: {name — e.g. "User creates an order"}
1. {Client POST `/api/orders` with payload per `contracts/openapi.yaml#/paths/~1orders`}
2. {`orders` module validates + writes row status `DRAFT`}
3. {Event `order.created` published to queue}
4. {Worker `integration-erp` consumes, pushes to ERP, updates status to `SYNCED` or `SYNC_FAILED`}
5. {Failure: retry 3× exponential backoff, then enter dead-letter + alert}

### Flow B: {…}

## 5. Binding architecture decisions

Only those that **agents must not change without a new ADR**. Maximum 10 rows.

| # | Decision | ADR | Consequence if violated |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | {All DB access through repository layer, no queries in route handlers} | ADR-0003 | {Cannot swap ORM, tests require real DB} |
| 2 | {Order state changes only through state machine in `orders/state.ts`} | ADR-0007 | {Inconsistent status, race conditions} |
| 3 | {No shared mutable singletons across requests} | ADR-0011 | {Data leaks between tenants} |

---

## 6. What was INTENTIONALLY not done

This section prevents agents from "helping" by adding things we already rejected.

- {No microservices — team too small, inter-service latency not worth it}
- {No GraphQL — single client, REST + OpenAPI is sufficient}
- {No caching layer in v1 — no evidence of need yet, adds complexity}
- {No global soft delete — only on tables audited by regulators}

---

## 7. Cross-agent synchronization points

The files below are **single sources of truth**. If markdown and these files differ,
these files are correct and the markdown is wrong.

| Contract | File | Owner (may write) | Consumer (read only) |
|---|---|---|---|
| API | `contracts/openapi.yaml` | api-designer | frontend, backend, qa |
| DB schema | `contracts/schema.sql` or `prisma/schema.prisma` | data | backend |
| Design tokens | `contracts/tokens.json` | ui-ux | frontend |
| Error taxonomy | `contracts/errors.catalog.json` | api-designer | frontend, backend |
| Acceptance criteria | `acceptance/*.feature` | ba-spec | qa, frontend, backend |

Details on who may write which files: `OWNERSHIP.md`.
